name: Blasting Charges
text: Once per turning point, one friendly Neophyte can shoot with a blasting charge: 4 attack dice, Hit 4+, damage 3 and 5, Range 4 inches, Blast 1 inch, Saturate.

name: Cult Knives
text: Every friendly Neophyte gains a cult knife: 3 attack dice, Hit 4+, damage 3 and 4.

name: Explosive Traps
text: Two Mines markers in one pick (the universal Mines cannot be added for a third). Your own Wyrmblade operatives cross them safely: they neither set them off nor take their damage.

name: Spotlights
text: Lit targets cannot hide: when a Wyrmblade shoots, its target loses obscured if a friendly Neophyte with no enemy in its control range can see that target within 6 inches.
